topic: how to increase chase debit card limit
slug: how to increase chase debit card limit

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your TOTAL CHECKING account, then tap "Manage account".
Check the card settings: the app doesn't offer a toggle for debit card daily limits.
Debit cards carry two limits: a daily ATM withdrawal limit and a separate daily purchase limit; both are set by Chase based on your account.
Tap "Contact us" and call 1-800-935-9935 to ask for higher limits. They're reviewed case by case and aren't guaranteed.
A branch visit is the other option, and teller withdrawals don't count against your ATM limit.
For bigger purchases, split the payment or use a credit card; transactions above the limit are simply declined, with no fee.
